name: Protecting Our Places

administered_by.name: NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

summary: Two-stage grants for New South Wales Aboriginal community organisations to plan, then carry out, on-ground protection and restoration of culturally important landscapes and waterways.
reporting: A project implementation plan after the planning stage, progress reports for stages 2 and 3, and a final report with financial certification at project end.

eligibility.rule: If not a listed NSW Aboriginal body type: has an organisation acting as External Manager
If an ACNC-registered charity company, its main objective is supporting ATSI people in NSW
If an association or co-op: not-for-profit, and benefits and involves local Aboriginal people
Be an Aboriginal group, organisation, or company
Not a profit-distributing corporation or co-operative (limited by shares)

documents: Governing body or board endorsement of the project

pool.quote: A total of $1 million is available for the 2026 round of the program.

applicant_types.quote: The following NSW Aboriginal community organisations/groups may apply: NSW Local Aboriginal Land Councils (LALCs) NSW Aboriginal Corporations registered under the Corporations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) Act 2006

geography.quote: We are dedicated to supporting proposals that provide meaningful benefits to the natural environment of New South Wales.

access.quote: If you plan to apply for a Protecting Our Places grant, the following resources will help you complete your application.

window.quote: Application opened: 15 June 2026 Application closed: 31 July 2026, 11:59 pm

amount.quote: Grants of between $150,000 to $250,000 can be awarded per project.

administered_by.quote: This program is administered by Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water.

reporting.quote: Stage 1 Planning $20,000 6 to 12 months Project Implementation Plan Stage 2 Implementation $115,000 12 months Progress Report -Stage 2 Stage 3 Implementation final payment $115,000 12 months Progress Report - Stage 3 Project end End of project Final Report and Financial Certification

effort.quote: Applications are assessed by an independent technical review committee with members from the general community, industry, and government.

eligibility.quote: Other Aboriginal organisations and groups are eligible to apply, however, these entities will need the support of another organisation that will perform the role of External Manager.

applicants under this category must also demonstrate that their organisation's primary objective is to support members and/or persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander (ATSI) descent in New South Wales.

Associations and Co-operatives will undergo additional eligibility checks to ensure they are not-for-profit/non-distributing and that the organisation's objectives and activities seek to provide benefits for and involves the participation of local Aboriginal people and communities.
profit-distributing corporations or co-operatives (limited by shares).

after_award.quote: Stage 1 Planning $20,000 6 to 12 months Project Implementation Plan Stage 2 Implementation $115,000 12 months Progress Report -Stage 2 Stage 3 Implementation final payment $115,000 12 months Progress Report - Stage 3 Project end End of project Final Report and Financial Certification
attending the required site visits and planning workshops.
$3,000 of Trust funds must be quarantined to pay for an independent accountant to certify your expenditure and financial report and provide a Report on Factual Findings at the end of the project.

documents.quote: Charities registered under the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission must provide a copy of their constitution to prove that their primary objective is to support ATSI persons
A project works map must be included with your application.
Written confirmation that your body/board is aware of the project and their endorsement is required.

co_finance_required.quote: Although not a requirement, co-contributions by applicants and any project partners will improve the chances of success.
